Company Overview: Figma is a collaborative canvas and product development platform that connects design, code, and AI in a single workspace. It empowers teams to turn ideas into apps, websites, and products while streamlining collaboration from brainstorming to production.
Target Audience: Product teams, UI/UX designers, developers, and growing organizations building applications and digital products.
